newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends lower, trade sluggish.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends lower, trade sluggish.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures drifted lower during late trading on Friday, with the trend reflecting a lack of interest in featureless conditions.
Traders said the market was generally looking to consolidate after Thursday's price falls. Physicals were slow, while New York was also under pressure, they noted.
March finished the session at $302.50 a tonne, down $1.90 from Thursday. Other contracts nearby shed $2.00 to $0.50 a tonne, with volume reaching just 1,644 lots.
